title: Voter Record Discrepancy — Statewide Database Comparison

fields.organization: Lisle County Board of Elections — Voter Registration
fields.summary: I have completed a direct comparison of the 1,186 altered voter records in VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) against the official statewide voter registration database via the Ohio Secretary of State’s secure portal (SOS-001). All 1,186 records were falsely marked as 'Ballot Issued' in the county system. No records were deleted or altered in the statewide database. The discrepancy confirms unauthorized edits in VoterTrack. A clean feed from the state database is required to correct these entries. The last good export from LCBOE-FS01 (10/28/2026) is intact and matches the state database. The air-gapped copy from LCBOE-PB01 is ready for use.

findings.notes: All 1,186 records match the official statewide database; no deletions, no changes
Nightly export on LCBOE-FS01 (10/28/2026) matches state database and was not altered
LCBOE-PB01 confirmed unaltered; hash matches digital signature
No MFA prompt logged for user nruiz@lislevotes.example during compromise window
1,186 records show 'issued' status with no corresponding ballot in the mailing log
Rule to nruiz.archive@mailbox-relay.example was detected and removed
Pollbook data feed from VoterTrack corrupted; results website failed to load
Spurious relocation notice and CISA alert page were posted to results.lislevotes.example
Poll workers in Precincts 111 and 112 are using paper lists and provisional ballots

findings.item: Chain of custody for forensic evidence
findings.notes: COOP-DR-5 and SHA-256: 5c0e9a7d3f21b84e6a90c1d27f43b58e9a6d0c2f71b34e85a9d06c3f2e71b48a are preserved

actionsTaken: Verified 1,186 records against the Ohio Secretary of State’s secure portal (SOS-001)
Confirmed integrity of the 10/28/2026 export on LCBOE-FS01
Reviewed logs from LCBOE-SQL01 and confirmed unauthorized session from IP 10.100.45.12
Notified IT, CEO, and VSM of verification results
Prepared to initiate pollbook rebuild using trusted air-gapped copy from LCBOE-PB01
recommendations: Immediately request a clean data feed from the Ohio Secretary of State’s secure portal (SOS-001) for Precincts 111 and 112
Do not push any new pollbook load until verification is complete
Rebuild Polling Location 6’s pollbook using the trusted air-gapped export from LCBOE-PB01
Declare CIRP 2 under Section 5 of the EOP; all automated processes remain suspended until verification is complete
Communicate verification status to the Public Information Officer for unified messaging
fields.photosNote: 6 photos attached: IMG_1024-1110-01 (SOS-001 portal), IMG_1024-1110-02 (VoterTrack export diff), IMG_1024-1110-03 (LCBOE-PB01 terminal), IMG_1024-1110-04 (COOP-DR-5 seal), IMG_1024-1110-05 (SOS-001 login screen), IMG_1024-1110-06 (state database comparison table)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the data discrepancy and validates the path to recovery via the trusted export. The Voter Registration Manager now has authority to direct the correction process. Watch for teams to defer to her verification before restoring automated systems.
